description:
Guided by our vision to be the “Best Bank for a Better World”, DBS seeks to create long-term value for stakeholders in a sustainable way. We see sustainability as an active value driver that offers new opportunities, enhances resilience against sustainability-related risks and strengthens trust with our stakeholders.

  

**Functions of the CSO Team**

The Chief Sustainability Office (CSO) sets DBS’ Group-wide sustainability direction and governance agenda and coordinates delivery of its sustainability commitments with teams across the bank. It serves as a central team supporting senior management in integrating the Group’s strategic sustainability direction into the business.

The CSO works with senior management and key governance forums, including the Board Sustainability Committee, Group Sustainability Council and Group Climate Council, to align priorities and drive delivery against the Group’s sustainability scorecard. It leads or coordinates strategic sustainability initiatives and develops relevant policies, frameworks and guidance to support consistent implementation across the bank.

The CSO also brings an outside-in view of market, regulatory, and client trends, and translate these into clear, practical actions for the bank. It leads sustainability reporting and engagement with key external stakeholders on sustainability matters, including regulators, investors, industry bodies and ecosystem partners.

We are seeking an **Associate** who can analyse and synthesise complex information, to provide strategic insights and actionable recommendations to inform decisions and delivery of the bank’s strategic sustainability priorities. The role will also involve the coordination and delivery of agreed actions across multiple stakeholders. The role suits a rigorous, adaptable thinker who challenges assumptions, exercises sound judgement. The successful candidate should also demonstrate curiosity, a growth mindset and a willingness to learn across different sustainability workstreams.

  

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

This role offers the opportunity to work across the Chief Sustainability Office’s priorities. The Associate will be expected to:

* **Contribute to strategic priorities** by supporting senior management and key governance forums with concise analyses, recommendations, agendas and papers, and helping to follow agreed actions through to completion.
* **Translate external developments** into practical insights by assessing relevant market, regulatory, technology and industry trends and identifying their implications for DBS.
* **Engage teams across DBS units and markets** to shape the approach, coordinate implementation and support consistent delivery of sustainability priorities.
* **Support internal engagements and capability building across the bank** by developing practical tools, guidance, communications and learning initiatives.
* **Support external engagements** with regulators, industry groups and ecosystem partners by coordinating inputs, preparing relevant materials and ensuring clear follow-through on agreed actions.

  

**First-Year Success Profile**

* Build a strong understanding of DBS’ sustainability priorities, governance and stakeholder landscape.
* Deliver assigned works to agreed scope, milestones and quality standards, with challenges/risks surfaced early.
Earn trust with senior stakeholders through well-supported recommendations, crisp executive materials and reliable follow-through.  

**Differentiated Capabilities**

* Strong interest and working knowledge of key sustainability-related themes and developments (e.g. regulatory, geopolitical, technological), with the judgement to distinguish signal from noise.
* Applies critical thinking to complex or ambiguous issues, developing clear options, well-supported recommendations and practical next steps.
* Engages stakeholders effectively by building constructive working relationships, adapting communication for different audiences.
Takes ownership of assigned work with high attention to detail and adapts constructively while working collaboratively with others.  

**Preferred Experience and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or postgraduate degree in sustainability/environmental, business, finance or a related field.
* Two or more years of working experience in a relevant field, exposure to financial services is advantageous.
* Experience managing projects involving multiple stakeholders.
* Experience conducting qualitative and quantitative analysis to develop executive-ready materials with clear insights and recommendations.

**Location:**

DBS Asia Central

**Job:**

Strategic Planning

**Schedule:**

Regular

**Employee Status:**

Full time

description:
Job Description
  
  
As an Environmental Control Officer (ECO), you will support clients in the implementation, management, and monitoring of environmental health and compliance requirements across construction projects. The role involves ensuring compliance with applicable environmental regulations, promoting environmental best practices, and supporting project teams in maintaining a safe and environmentally responsible worksite.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing environmental control measures, conducting inspections and audits, coordinating with regulatory authorities, and driving environmental awareness initiatives to ensure compliance with statutory and client requirements.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Perform duties as a registered Environmental Control Officer (ECO) for construction projects in accordance with applicable regulations.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable environmental and statutory requirements imposed by regulatory authorities and clients.
* Liaise with consultants, contractors, clients, and relevant authorities including the National Environment Agency (NEA), Ministry of Manpower (MOM), Public Utilities Board (PUB), National Parks Board (NParks), and other stakeholders on environmental matters.
* Monitor and assess environmental aspects of site operations, including air quality, noise levels, water quality, environmental control measures (ECM), waste management, housekeeping, pest control, and sanitation practices.
* Conduct routine environmental inspections and audits to identify areas of non-compliance and opportunities for improvement.
* Recommend and implement reasonably practicable measures to mitigate environmental risks and prevent pollution incidents.
* Manage and monitor the storage, handling, and usage of hazardous substances in accordance with applicable regulations and best practices.
* Coordinate environmental monitoring programmes and maintain records of inspections, audits, monitoring results, and corrective actions.
* Investigate environmental incidents, complaints, and non-conformances, and recommend corrective and preventive measures.
* Organise and conduct environmental health awareness programmes, inductions, toolbox talks, and training sessions for site personnel.
* Prepare environmental reports and compile data for monthly submissions and management review.
* Maintain all environmental compliance documentation in accordance with client and regulatory requirements.
* Support clients in achieving project-specific environmental objectives and sustainability initiatives where required.
* Perform other environmental-related duties and ad hoc assignments as required by the Client.

Job Requirements
  
  

* Mustbe registered with the National Environment Agency (NEA) as an Environmental Control Officer (ECO).
* Minimum2 to 3 years of relevant experience in environmental management within the construction industry.
* Good knowledge of Singapore environmental regulations, compliance requirements, and industry best practices.
* Experience liaising with regulatory authorities such as NEA, MOM, PUB, and NParks.
* Strong understanding of environmental monitoring, waste management, pollution control, housekeeping, sanitation, and hazardous substance management.
* Experience conducting environmental inspections, audits, investigations, and training programmes.
* Strong observation, analytical, problem-solving, and organisational skills.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels.
* Abilityto work independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and documentation management.

**Employment Type:**  
Contract (duration to be determined based on Client requirements), with extension or renewal subject to the Client's requirements and project needs.

We deliver comprehensive, integrated, and client-focused solutions to cover a multitude of technical disciplines. Leveraging our established professional relationships with regulatory authorities, whilst drawing on our deep local and legislative insights, we are committed to successfully managing your environment, safety, and sustainability project needs.
  
  
Trusted by clients from Asia and beyond, we are consistently recognized for our innovative services and insightful solutions to bring you exceptional value. ESC supports our regional clients with the largest local teams of experienced consultants.
  
  
Our Mission is to bring our talent, expertise, and experience across the Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG) spectrum to provide smart, cost-effective and practical solutions to the EHS and Sustainability challenges our clients and the broader community face.
  
  
We invite you to develop your fullest potential, hone the right technical skills and sharpen your environment, safety, and sustainability knowledge with high performing and global team of experts.
  
  
With a collaborative and empowering culture, ESC attracts and retains multidisciplinary and excellent employees. Our talents are drawn from a mix of nationalities and professional backgrounds with an extensive Asian and international experience.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Communications & Content Development
  
  
Develop engaging communications materials, including articles, social media content, newsletters, presentations, infographics and other digital content.
  
  
Translate technical information on climate resilience, sustainable agriculture and carbon finance into clear and compelling narratives for different audiences.
  
  
Support the development of key messages, storytelling and communications materials that showcase WWF's climate programmes.
  
  
Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to source stories, case studies and other content.
  
  
2. Communications Campaigns & Outreach
  
  
Support the planning and execution of communications campaigns to raise the visibility of WWF-Singapore's climate initiatives.
  
  
Coordinate content publication across WWF's digital platforms, social media and partner communications channels.
  
  
Support media engagement activities, including drafting press releases, media briefs and other publicity materials.
  
  
Track communications performance and prepare updates on outreach and engagement outcomes.
  
  
3. Partner & Coalition Communications
  
  
Support communications and engagement activities for WWF Singapore’s Climate activities including related Coalitions
  
  
Develop partner-facing communications materials, including newsletters, presentations, updates and briefing documents.
  
  
Coordinate with coalition partners on joint communications, announcements and storytelling opportunities.
  
  
Support communications for stakeholder events, workshops, roundtables and regional convenings.
  
  
4. Programme & Communications Coordination
  
  
Work closely with WWF's Strategic Communications teams to ensure consistent messaging and alignment with WWF's brand and communications priorities.
  
  
Support the development and implementation of communications plans for climate programmes.
  
  
Coordinate with external vendors, designers and content creators where required.
  
  
Maintain communications calendars, content libraries and relevant reporting materials.
  
  
Qualifications & Experience
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, Public Relations, Environmental Studies or a related field.
  
  
2–4 years of relevant experience in communications, content development, digital marketing, public relations or related fields.
  
  
Strong writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate complex topics clearly and engagingly.
  
  
Experience developing content for digital platforms, social media and stakeholder communications.
  
  
Familiarity with climate change, sustainability, agriculture or environmental issues would be advantageous.
  
  
Basic graphic design, video editing or multimedia content creation skills would be an advantage.
  
  
Strong organisational and project coordination skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple assignments.
  
  
Proactive, creative and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively across teams and with external partners.
  
  
Why Join Us
  
  
Join WWF-Singapore to help tell the stories that inspire action for climate, nature and communities. You will contribute to high-impact regional initiatives, working with diverse partners to raise awareness and accelerate solutions for climate resilience, sustainable food systems and nature-positive development across Southeast Asia.

Interested applicants are encouraged to complete the online application form -

World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF) is one of the world’s largest and most respected independent conservation organisations. WWF’s mission is to stop the degradation of Earth’s natural environment and to build
  
a future in which humans live in harmony with nature. As one of WWF’s international hubs, WWF-Singapore supports a global network spanning over 100 countries.

As part of OCBC’s ambition to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future, you will play a senior role in shaping and delivering the Group’s sustainability agenda. Working closely with the Group Chief Sustainability Officer, senior management, businesses and subsidiaries, you will help translate this ambition into clear priorities, practical initiatives, stakeholder engagement strategies and measurable outcomes.

You will partner businesses and subsidiaries across markets to advance opportunities, manage risks, strengthen governance and disclosures, shape stakeholder engagement, and represent OCBC in the wider sustainability and financial sector ecosystem.

  

**How you succeed**

  

You combine strategic judgement with a pragmatic, hands-on approach to execution. You build strong partnerships across business, risk and support functions, and translate complex and emerging sustainability topics into clear direction, practical actions and credible narratives for internal and external stakeholders.

  

**What you will be doing:**

* Develop, review and support the implementation of the Group’s sustainability strategy, priorities and commitments, translating them into actionable plans, initiatives and measurable outcomes.
* Drive cross-functional initiatives, partnering business units, subsidiaries and support functions to identify, shape and deliver sustainability-related initiatives, including business solutions as well as internal process improvements and capabilities.
* Support the development, review, promotion and implementation of sustainability policies, frameworks, standards, practices and reporting in collaboration with business units and relevant control functions.
* Monitor sustainability, regulatory, risk, market, industry and competitive developments, translating insights into opportunities, risks and strategic implications for the Board and senior management.
* Represent OCBC at industry forums, conferences, roundtables and other engagements, and contribute to thought leadership on sustainable/transition finance and emerging sustainability topics.
* Oversee the development of appropriate positioning and messaging on key sustainability topics across markets.
* Build and manage relationships with regulators, government bodies, industry associations and ecosystem partners to support OCBC’s sustainability agenda, franchise and market positioning.

**What we are looking for:**

* Graduate degree from an accredited university or equivalent.
* At least 15 years of relevant experience, with demonstrated success in banking, financial services, sustainable finance, sustainability or a related field.
* Strong understanding and prior experience of financial institutions and how sustainability considerations apply across the sector would be an advantage.
* In-depth knowledge of sustainability frameworks, taxonomies, regulatory and industry developments in Singapore and the region.
* A forward-looking and practical problem solver who can identify key issues, simplify complexity and translate insights into actionable recommendations and solutions.
* Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives, influence senior stakeholders across businesses, functions, regions and cultures, and plan, prioritise and deliver multiple workstreams concurrently with strong execution discipline and attention to detail.
* Excellent stakeholder management, strategic thinking and communication skills, with experience representing an organisation externally and briefing senior leaders.
* Collaborative team player who builds trust across teams and with stakeholders, and demonstrates OCBC’s values of Lasting Value, Integrity, Forward-looking, Respect and Responsibility in how work is delivered.

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.
